title: Assets under supervision by asset class
note: Total $4,097bn. Firm-wide, including wealth management; not the Client Solutions Group's assets.

title: Long-term AUS by client channel
note: Total long-term $3,046bn. 'Third-party distributed' is the filing's name for the third-party wealth channel. Global figures; no regional split by channel is published.

title: Asset & Wealth Management net revenues by line
note: Total $16.679bn. Management and other fees are the recurring line; incentive fees and investments vary from year to year.

title: Share of Goldman Sachs net revenues
note: Asset management and wealth management together are the AWM segment (28.6%). 'About 30%' describes the segment, not asset management alone.

title: Average effective management fee by asset class
note: Firm-wide blended rates excluding non-asset-based fees. They are not the price of any mandate.

title: Long-term net inflows by client channel
note: Total $250bn. Net of outflows; includes assets that arrived through acquisitions.

title: Global OCIO assets: public markers
note: Three statements by Goldman: 'nearly $450bn' (September 2025, no as-of date), $480bn (31 March 2026), '$540bn+' (30 June 2026). An earlier marker of 'more than £200bn' (September 2023) is in sterling and is left off. Global, not UK.

title: UK fiduciary and OCIO appointments by disclosed size
note: Scheme assets at announcement, not fee-paying revenue and not Goldman's fees. Shell figure is the UK portion (about $15.6bn) of a $40bn appointment.

title: Assets under supervision by region
note: EMEA is 19.5% of the total. No UK figure is published.
